stem.text: Nitrogen monoxide is an atmospheric pollutant that is formed inside car engines by an endothermic reaction between nitrogen and oxygen.
Which diagram correctly represents the energy profile for this reaction?

A.alt: Energy profile diagram with products above reactants, labelled Ea and ΔH

B.alt: Energy profile diagram with products above reactants, labelled Ea and ΔH

C.alt: Energy profile diagram with reactants above products, labelled ΔH and Ea

D.alt: Energy profile diagram with reactants above products, labelled ΔH and Ea
